report.description: Attio is a modern CRM platform that offers a RESTful API, custom objects, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for AI integration, with tiered pricing that includes API and webhook access.
report.main_blocker: API access may require an approved developer status or a paid plan tier.

evidence.claim: Developers can create a developer account, register an integration, set scopes, and generate an access token to authenticate API calls.
Attio provides a REST API covering objects, attributes, and records with extensive documentation.
Attio offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI tools to securely access the workspace.
The official Attio MCP documentation describes MCP as an open standard for connecting AI assistants to the CRM.
API and webhook access are listed as features on Pro and Enterprise pricing tiers.
